detail.question: Combien de commandes par mois en 2017 ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
  TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS date_commande,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS annee,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS mois,
  COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes
FROM
  entrepot."orders"
WHERE
  TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
GROUP BY
  annee, mois, date_commande
ORDER BY
  annee, mois
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires mois par mois en 2018 ?

SELECT

  SUM(entrepot."order_payments".payment_value) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM
  entrepot."orders"
  JOIN entrepot."order_payments" ON entrepot."orders".order_id = entrepot."order_payments".order_id
WHERE

GROUP BY

detail.question: Quelles categories de produits ont le panier moyen le plus eleve, avec leur nom en anglais ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH panier_moyen_par_categorie AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name,
    pct.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS panier_moyen
  FROM
    entrepot."order_items" oi
  JOIN
    entrepot."products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN
    entrepot."product_category_name_translation" pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  JOIN
    entrepot."orders" o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY
    p.product_category_name, pct.product_category_name_english
)

SELECT
  product_category_name AS "Catégorie de produit",
  product_category_name_english AS "Nom en anglais",
  panier_moyen AS "Panier moyen"
FROM
  panier_moyen_par_categorie
ORDER BY
  panier_moyen DESC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Les vendeurs de quels etats livrent le plus vite ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH livraisons AS (
  SELECT
    s.seller_state,
    o.order_approved_at,
    o.order_delivered_customer_date,
    (TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) - TRY_CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS temps_livraison
  FROM
    entrepot.orders o
  JOIN
    entrepot.sellers s ON o.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) > TRY_CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP)
)

SELECT
  seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
  AVG(temps_livraison) AS temps_moyen_livraison_jour,
  COUNT(*) AS nombre_livraisons
FROM
  livraisons
GROUP BY
  seller_state
ORDER BY
  temps_moyen_livraison_jour ASC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quelle est la note moyenne par categorie de produit, en anglais, pour les categories evaluees au moins cinq cents fois ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH categories_evaluees AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name_english,
    COUNT(DISTINCT or.order_id) AS nombre_evaluations
  FROM
    entrepot.products p
  JOIN
    entrepot.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN
    entrepot.orders or ON oi.order_id = or.order_id
  JOIN
    entrepot.order_reviews orr ON or.order_id = orr.order_id
  GROUP BY
    p.product_category_name_english
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT or.order_id) >= 500
)

SELECT
  ce.product_category_name_english AS "Categorie de produit (anglais)",
  AVG(orr.review_score) AS "Note moyenne"
FROM
  categories_evaluees ce
JOIN
  entrepot.products p ON ce.product_category_name_english = p.product_category_name_english
JOIN
  entrepot.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN
  entrepot.orders or ON oi.order_id = or.order_id
JOIN
  entrepot.order_reviews orr ON or.order_id = orr.order_id
GROUP BY
  ce.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY
  "Note moyenne" DESC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Le chiffre d'affaires du second semestre 2017 est-il superieur a celui du premier ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH semestre_chiffre_affaires AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(payment_value) AS chiffre_affaires,
    CASE
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2017-06-30' THEN 'Premier semestre'
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2017-12-31' THEN 'Second semestre'
    END AS semestre
  FROM
    entrepot."order_payments"
  JOIN
    entrepot."orders" ON entrepot."order_payments".order_id = entrepot."orders".order_id
  WHERE
    entrepot."orders".order_status = 'approved'
    AND TRY_CAST(order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2017-12-31'
    AND TRY_CAST(order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    semestre
)

SELECT
  semestre,
  chiffre_affaires,
  CASE
    WHEN semestre = 'Premier semestre' THEN 'Non'
    WHEN semestre = 'Second semestre' AND chiffre_affaires > (
      SELECT chiffre_affaires
      FROM semestre_chiffre_affaires
      WHERE semestre = 'Premier semestre'
    ) THEN 'Oui'
    ELSE 'Non'
  END AS chiffre_affaires_superieur
FROM
  semestre_chiffre_affaires
ORDER BY
  semestre;

detail.question: Le delai de livraison moyen a-t-il change entre 2017 et 2018 ?
detail.sql_produit: WITH delais_2017 AS (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('day', TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) ELSE NULL END) AS delai_moyen_2017 FROM entrepot."orders" WHERE TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' AND NOT order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL), delais_2018 AS (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_DIFF('day', TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) ELSE NULL END) AS delai_moyen_2018 FROM entrepot."orders" WHERE TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-12-31' AND NOT order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL) SELECT delais_2017.delai_moyen_2017, delais_2018.delai_moyen_2018, delais_2018.delai_moyen_2018 - delais_2017.delai_moyen_2017 AS difference FROM delais_2017, delais_2018

detail.question: Quel trimestre de 2018 a le mieux marche en volume ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH trimestres_2018 AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-03-31' THEN 'T1'
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-06-30' THEN 'T2'
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-09-30' THEN 'T3'
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-10-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-12-31' THEN 'T4'
    END AS trimestre,
    COUNT(*) AS volume
  FROM entrepot."orders"
  WHERE TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT
  trimestre,
  volume
FROM trimestres_2018
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 1
